text.en:
The Ferrol-Buenavista Looc Provincial Road, the Linawan-Mablaran Falls Provincial Road both
in the Island of Tablas and the Magdiwang-Agtiwa-San Fernando Provincial Road in the Island of Sibuyan, all
in the Province of Romblon, are converted into national roads.

The amount necessary for the improvement and maintenance of said roads shall continue to be
funded out of the lump sum appropriation authorized under Batas Pambansa Blg. 640 for the repair and
maintenance of local roads until such time that the maintenance funds for said roads shall have been provided
for in the succeeding appropriations acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
